item.title: China AI Chipmakers' Homegrown Scale-Up Interconnect Scorecard
item.description: A technical scorecard ranks Cambricon MLU-Link, Enflame GCU-LARE, Biren BLink, MetaX and Moore Threads MTLink on bandwidth and deployment-evidence tiers for accelerator scale-up fabrics — ecosystem depth, not fundraising.

item.title: ACE Robotics and NTU Open-Source Puffin-World Multimodal World Model
item.description: ACE Robotics and NTU S-Lab open-sourced Puffin-World, unifying physics, geometry and appearance world states on Puffin-16M data and reporting SOTA camera absolute pose errors to sub-degree on four public benchmarks.

item.title: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B as Open On-Device SOTA Under 4B
item.description: OpenBMB and ModelBest open-sourced MiniCPM5-2B, a 2.52B dense Apache-2.0 model with 131K context averaging 53.9 across 34 benchmarks and beating some 4B open baselines on coding, tools and long context.

item.title: Cambricon Day-0 Adapts DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on vLLM Stack
item.description: Cambricon completed same-day DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash enablement on vLLM, pairing Torch-MLU-Ops and BangC kernels with NeuWare. The story is chip-side Day-0 co-availability, not another model launch recap.

item.title: Huawei Ascend 950DT and Cambricon Raise AI Accelerator Quotes on HBM Squeeze
item.description: Huawei lifted Ascend 950DT indicative quotes past about 250,000 yuan and Cambricon raised planned 690 pricing 20%–30%, Reuters and Bloomberg report, as HBM shortages lift domestic AI card costs ahead of 950DT's Q4 2026 window.
